APA Correlation Matrix Table (from raw data)

create_apa_corr_table.Rd

Creates an APA-formatted correlation matrix table with means, SDs, sample sizes, and significance stars using psych::corr.test(). This function always computes correlations from the raw data.

Usage

create_apa_corr_table(
  data,
  vars,
  var_labels = NULL,
  table_title = "Means, Standard Deviations, and Correlations"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

vars

Character vector. Variable names to include in the matrix.

var_labels

Character vector or NULL. Display labels for variables. If NULL, labels are auto-generated as numbered variable names.

table_title

Character. Table caption text.

Value

A flextable::flextable() object.

Examples

data(superman)
sm <- superman[, c("clark_height_in", "rt_critics_score", "rt_audience_score")]
sm <- sm[stats::complete.cases(sm), ]
ft <- create_apa_corr_table(sm,
  vars = c("clark_height_in", "rt_critics_score", "rt_audience_score"),
  var_labels = c("1. Clark Height", "2. Critics Score", "3. Audience Score")
)
